description:
GH: https://github.com/theodoreOnzGit/kopitiam/issues/1

`kopitiam check` and `kopitiam test` always run the `dev` profile — got no way
to ask for `--release` at all. For this workspace that's damn jialat lah: our own
CLAUDE.md Build Rules say release-mode only, so kopitiam's own diagnostics cannot
be the authoritative check. You ask a release-profile question, you get a
dev-profile answer.

Not cosmetic hor — release changes real behaviour: overflow checks off,
different optimisation-dependent timing/precision paths. A suite green in dev can
still die in release, so a dev-only `kopitiam test` can report a false all-clear.

What to add (apps/cli/src/diagnostics.rs, CheckArgs + TestArgs):
  * `--release`  -> `cargo check --release` / `cargo test --release`
  * `--profile <NAME>` -> `--profile <NAME>` for custom profiles
  * both must flow through `base_command()` so passthrough AND
    --compact/--json paths get the same profile.

Lower priority extras from the reporter:
  * trailing cargo passthrough (`kopitiam check -- --all-targets`) — matters
    because examples/tests must compile for an Android target and a --lib-only
    check silently misses them.
  * doc nit: `check`'s one-line summary says "report one deduplicated line per
    distinct diagnostic", but the dedup is opt-in via `--compact`. Summary line
    running ahead of itself.
title: kopitiam check/test: no --release / --profile flag (blocks release-only workspaces)
